title: A cleaner orders workspace
body: Orders got a faster table, clearer statuses, and quicker filters.
changelog:
## A cleaner orders workspace
The orders screen was rebuilt from the ground up.

- A faster table that stays smooth on large stores
- Clearer status pills so you can scan orders at a glance
- Filters now apply instantly, without a full page reload

features.banner: The orders workspace has been refreshed

title: Pickup times just got more flexible
body: Manage pickup availability by day of the week and set the hours that work for your business.
changelog:
## Pickup times just got more flexible
Manage pickup availability by day of the week, each with its own hours.

- Turn pickup on or off for individual days
- Set pickup start and end times per day
- Save a weekly schedule that fits your business

features.label: Pickup Times
features.title: Pickup times just got more flexible
features.description: You can now manage pickup availability by day of the week. Turn pickup on or off for individual days and set pickup hours that work for your business.

deltaTour.text: Turn pickup on or off for each day here.
Set the pickup hours for active days.

steps.title: Control pickup availability by day
steps.body: Use the toggle beside each day to choose when pickup is available.

steps.title: Set pickup hours
steps.body: For active days, select the pickup start and end times that work for your business.
steps.fallbackBody: Turn on at least one day to choose its pickup start and end times.

steps.title: Save your schedule
steps.body: Review your pickup days and hours, then save your changes when you're ready.

title: Shipments just got easier
body: We've redesigned shipments so you can find, track, and manage deliveries faster.
changelog:
## Shipments, redesigned
Create, track, and manage deliveries from a single screen.

## What changed
- One flow from order to delivery, no more separate pages
- Live tracking on the same screen where you create the shipment
- Faster search across all your shipments

features.label: Shipments
features.title: Shipments just got easier
features.description: We've redesigned shipments so you can find, track, and manage deliveries faster.

deltaTour.text: Create a shipment from a ready order here.
Track delivery status on the same screen.

steps.title: Open an order that's ready to ship
steps.body: Orders awaiting shipment appear here. Open one to review its details and create a shipment.

steps.title: Check the shipment status
steps.body: This order is currently Awaiting Shipment, meaning it's ready for you to create a shipment.

steps.title: Create a shipment
steps.body: When an order is ready to leave your store, create a shipment to begin the delivery process.
steps.instruction: Click the "Create Shipment" button to continue.

steps.title: Pay the shipping fee
steps.body: Shipping fees are settled when the shipment is created. Continue to payment to book this shipment and start tracking its delivery.
steps.instruction: Click the "Continue to Payment" button to continue.

steps.title: Shipment created successfully
steps.body: Your shipment has been created and is now ready to be tracked. Return to the shipment details to view its updated status.

steps.title: Track and manage your shipment
steps.body: Your shipment is now active. From here, you can monitor its status, review tracking details, and manage delivery updates.

title: Create discounts in minutes
body: Reward loyal customers or run promotions using percentage, fixed amount, or coupon discounts.
changelog:
## Discounts & coupons are here
Reward loyal customers and run promotions in minutes.

## What you can do
- Create percentage, fixed-amount, or coupon-based discounts
- Track each discount performance from one place
- Apply discounts across products or your whole store

features.label: Discounts & Coupons
features.title: Create discounts in minutes
features.description: Reward loyal customers or run promotions using percentage, fixed amount, or coupon discounts.

steps.title: Welcome to Discounts
steps.body: Manage all your discounts and promotional offers from one place. You'll be able to create, track, and update promotions anytime.

steps.title: Create your first discount
steps.body: Create discounts to encourage more purchases and reward your customers.
steps.instruction: Click the "Add Discount" button to continue.

steps.title: Choose the discount type
steps.body: Select the kind of promotion you want to offer. Discounts can be percentage-based, fixed amount, or other supported types.

steps.title: Create your discount
steps.body: Everything looks ready. Save your discount to make it available for customers.
steps.instruction: Click the "Create Discount" button to continue.

steps.title: Manage all your discounts in one place
steps.body: View each discount's status, type and performance from this list. Select any discount to see more details or make changes.
steps.instruction: Click the discount row to continue.

steps.title: Review and manage your discount
steps.body: Track your discount details, monitor activity and update the promotion whenever your campaign changes.
